Powered by the Model Context Protocol (MCP), allowing Skybits to work across AI tools instead of locking you into a single ecosystem

Control

CONTROL IS THE PRODUCT

Give agents real work. Keep human judgment in charge.

Skybits is designed for useful agency without invisible action. The faster the agents work, the more important clear boundaries and review become.

  • Reviewable

    Every AI content edit is reviewable

    Agent changes arrive as suggestions with authorship attached.

  • Enforced

    Every request is permission checked

    Credentials, document access, and risky operations are enforced on every call.

  • Recoverable

    Every important state can be recovered

    Versions, compare mode, history, and undo preserve a path back.

  • Auditable

    Every actor remains accountable

    Human and agent activity stays distinguishable and auditable.

FAQ

STRAIGHT ANSWERS

Clear documents. Clear answers.

Do I stop using Claude or ChatGPT?

No. Keep using the AI you prefer. Skybits gives it a controlled way to work in shared documents, alongside people and other agents.

What does Skybits add to my AI workflow?

A durable document, real-time collaboration, reviewable suggestions, scoped permissions, comments, history, organization, and one shared state everyone can build on.

Can several agents work on one document?

Yes. Each collaborator can bring the agent that fits their role. Their work converges in the same document without silently overwriting other contributors.

Are AI edits applied automatically?

No. AI content changes land as suggestions so a person can inspect, accept, or reject them.

How is Skybits different from Google Docs?

Google Docs is designed primarily for people collaboration. Skybits is built for people and AI collaboration. In addition to comments, sharing, version history, and collaborative editing, Skybits allows AI agents to participate directly in the document workflow. Agents can make precise edits, respond to feedback, propose changes, and collaborate alongside people instead of operating in separate chats or side panels.

How is Skybits different from ChatGPT Canvas and Claude Artifacts?

ChatGPT Canvas and Claude Artifacts are excellent tools for generating and refining content. Skybits focuses on what happens after the draft. Instead of keeping work inside a single AI platform, Skybits provides a shared document where multiple people and multiple AI agents can collaborate, review, comment, revise, and share work together. The goal is not just generating content. It’s helping teams turn AI output into durable, collaborative work.

Do I need to understand MCP?

No. Most users can start using Skybits immediately without knowing anything about MCP. MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the emerging standard that allows AI agents to work with external tools. Skybits uses MCP behind the scenes so it can connect to many different AI tools and agents, but you don’t need to learn the protocol to benefit from it.

Can I review AI changes before they are applied?

Yes. Skybits is built around human review and control. AI-generated changes can be reviewed before they are accepted, with clear attribution, version history, and visibility into what changed. You always keep the final say over important decisions and edits.

Which AI tools does Skybits work with?

Skybits works with: - ChatGPT - Claude - Cursor - Grok - Perplexity - Any MCP-compatible AI agent We also provide a dedicated Skybits Skill that allows AI agents to learn how to create, edit, review, search, and collaborate on Skybits documents directly. As the AI ecosystem evolves, Skybits is designed to remain model-neutral and work across tools rather than locking you into a single provider.

Who is Skybits for?

Skybits is designed for people who regularly create documents with AI and need to collaborate, review, approve, or share the result. Common users include: - Product managers writing PRDs and specifications - Founders creating strategy documents and investor updates - Consultants building client deliverables - Researchers and analysts producing reports and recommendations - Teams that increasingly work with AI-generated content If AI helps create the work, and people still need to review and improve it, Skybits is built for that workflow.

What should I try first?

Bring a real document you’re already working on. A PRD. A proposal. A strategy memo. A research report. A launch plan. Create the first draft with your favorite AI tool, move it into Skybits, and experience how much easier it is to review, refine, collaborate on, and share the result with your team.

Get Started

blocks.html_en: Skybits is designed for people who regularly create documents with AI and need to collaborate, review, approve, or share the result. Common users include: - Product managers writing PRDs and specifications - Founders creating strategy documents and investor updates - Consultants building client deliverables - Researchers and analysts producing reports and recommendations - Teams that increasingly work with AI-generated content If AI helps create the work, and people still need to review and improve it, Skybits is built for that workflow.

FAQ

直接答案

清晰的文件。 明确的答案。

Do I stop using Claude or ChatGPT?

不，继续使用你喜欢的人工智能。 Skybits 为其提供了一种与人员和其他代理一起处理共享文档的受控方式。

What does Skybits add to my AI workflow?

一份持久的文档、实时协作、可审查的建议、范围权限、评论、历史记录、组织以及每个人都可以构建的共享状态。

Can several agents work on one document?

是的。 每个合作者都可以携带适合其角色的代理。 他们的工作集中在同一个文档中，而不会默默地覆盖其他贡献者。

Are AI edits applied automatically?

不会。人工智能内容将土地更改为建议，以便人们可以检查、接受或拒绝它们。

How is Skybits different from Google Docs?

Google 文档主要是为人们协作而设计的。 Skybits 专为人与人工智能协作而构建。 除了评论、共享、版本历史和协作编辑之外，Skybits 还允许 AI 代理直接参与文档工作流程。 代理可以进行精确编辑、响应反馈、提出更改建议并与人员协作，而不是在单独的聊天或侧面板中进行操作。

How is Skybits different from ChatGPT Canvas and Claude Artifacts?

ChatGPT Canvas 和 Claude Artifacts 是生成和精炼内容的出色工具。 Skybits 关注选秀后发生的事情。 Skybits 没有将工作保留在单个人工智能平台内，而是提供了一个共享文档，多人和多个人工智能代理可以在其中协作、审查、评论、修改和共享工作。 目标不仅仅是生成内容。 它帮助团队将人工智能输出转化为持久的协作工作。

Do I need to understand MCP?

不会。大多数用户无需了解任何有关 MCP 的信息即可立即开始使用 Skybits。 MCP（模型上下文协议）是新兴标准，允许 AI 代理与外部工具配合使用。 Skybits 在幕后使用 MCP，因此它可以连接到许多不同的 AI 工具和代理，但您无需学习该协议即可从中受益。

Can I review AI changes before they are applied?

是的。 Skybits 是围绕人工审查和控制而构建的。 人工智能生成的更改可以在被接受之前进行审查，并具有清晰的归属、版本历史记录和对更改内容的可见性。 您始终对重要决策和编辑拥有最终决定权。

Which AI tools does Skybits work with?

Skybits 适用于： - ChatGPT - Claude - Cursor - Grok - Perplexity - 任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 代理 我们还提供专用的 Skybits 技能，允许 AI 代理学习如何直接创建、编辑、审查、搜索和协作处理 Skybits 文档。 随着人工智能生态系统的发展，Skybits 旨在保持模型中立并跨工具工作，而不是将您锁定在单一提供商。

Who is Skybits for?

Skybits 专为经常使用人工智能创建文档并需要协作、审查、批准或共享结果的人们而设计。 常见用户包括： - 编写 PRD 和规范的产品经理 - 创建战略文档和投资者更新的创始人 - 构建客户可交付成果的顾问 - 生成报告和建议的研究人员和分析师 - 越来越多地使用人工智能生成内容的团队 如果人工智能有助于创建工作，而人们仍然需要审查和改进它，那么 Skybits 就是为该工作流程而构建的。

What should I try first?

带上您正在处理的真实文档。 还有珠三角。 一个建议。 战略备忘录。 一份研究报告。 发射计划。 使用您最喜欢的 AI 工具创建初稿，将其移至 Skybits，体验审核、完善、协作以及与团队分享结果是多么容易。
